name: Citizenship by Marriage (Foreign Wife of a Malian Husband)

requirements.blocker_text: Code de la Nationalite Malienne, Article 23: a foreign woman who marries a Malian man acquires Malian nationality automatically upon the marriage -- she may decline this before the marriage takes place if her own national law lets her retain her original nationality. Article 24 gives the government a one-year window after the marriage to formally oppose the acquisition. There is NO symmetric automatic-acquisition route for a foreign man marrying a Malian woman -- see ml_citizenship_naturalisation.json for the reduced-residence (not automatic) naturalization track that applies instead in that case.
requirements.fix_path: Marry a Malian man; nationality is acquired automatically unless declined before the marriage or opposed by the government within one year after.

sources.title: Citizenship Rights in Africa Initiative (NGO-hosted primary legal text) -- Code de la Nationalite Malienne, Article 23 (foreign wife's automatic acquisition) and Article 24 (one-year government opposition window)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Mali). STATUS: DRAFT -- sourced to an NGO-hosted copy of the primary legal text, tier 3; the code's own Journal Officiel publication was not independently fetched -- disclosed gap. MARQUEE, CONFIRMED GENDER ASYMMETRY (not an open question like Algeria's comparable case, dz_citizenship_by_marriage.json -- this one is directly sourced and explicit): a foreign woman marrying a Malian man acquires citizenship automatically and immediately (subject only to a pre-marriage opt-out and a one-year government opposition window); a foreign man marrying a Malian woman gets NO automatic acquisition at all -- his only route is the ordinary naturalization process with a reduced 2-year residence threshold instead of the standard 5 years (Article 29, see ml_citizenship_naturalisation.json), still subject to full ministerial discretion and an unmotivated, unappealable decree. This is a real, sourced, structural difference in how the two directions of marriage are treated, not a modeling simplification. dual_citizenship_allowed left null: the source did not address whether the foreign wife must renounce her prior nationality upon automatic acquisition.
